pages.text: The $(l)Cyber Frame Block$() is CyberFarm's structural block. Many machines need one or more Cyber Frames beside them before they work, and the big chambers are built out of them. Craft a stack early: you will use a lot of them.
4 Iron Ingots and 4 Copper Ingots make $(l)8$() Cyber Frames. Iron and copper from other mods work too.
pages.title: Making it

pages.text: Most CyberFarm machines are small multiblocks: the machine plus a few Cyber Frames next to it.$(br)$(li)Place the machine.$(br)$(li)Right-click it alone: drones fly out and show where each frame goes.
pages.title: Small machines

pages.text: $(li)Place the frames there. The machine assembles itself and takes the frames into its shape.$(br)A machine works only once assembled. Break one of its frames and it folds back. Break the machine and its frames stay behind as plain Cyber Frames.

Two machines sit in a $(l)3x3x4 chamber$() of Cyber Frames and $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Containment Glass$(/l). Each chamber takes $(l)25$() Cyber Frames: a floor, the four corners and a roof.$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l): Acid Inlet, Methane Outlet$(br)$(li)$(l:mech/crystallizer)Crystallizer$(/l): Crystallizer Port
pages.title: Big chambers

pages.text: The $(l:basics/multiblock_projector)Multiblock Projector$(/l) shows both chambers in the world before you build them.

$(li)A Cyber Frame that is already part of a finished chamber does not count for a small machine.$(br)$(li)Once a small machine is built, its frames take cables, pipes and hoppers just like the machine block: connect wherever is handiest.
